takeaways.text: Route on **88%** / blocks on **12%** of dropbacks (95% CI 82–92%, n=169) — 6 pts above the RB average of 82%.
On routes, averages **3.9 yd** downfield by the throw (n=148, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Backfield (94%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.

example_plays.why: closest to his median route depth (4.1 yd) — a normal rep
farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
